# Stevanato Group Delivers 8% Revenue Growth for the Third Quarter of Fiscal 2026


November 03, 2026 6:30am EST


## Related Documents


[Earnings Webcast Audio Q3 2026](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=0tg2GT1q)


[Presentation Request PDF Q3 2026 (form required)](https://ir.stevanatogroup.com/financial-results#presentation-request)


[Prepared Comments PDF Q3 2026](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_dd92d5f5f99beb19287371168672cc5f/stevanatogroup/db/2017/65399/prepared_comments/Stevanato_Group_Q3_2026_Earnings_Conference_Call_Prepared_Comments_Nov_3_2026.pdf)


**The Company Maintains Fiscal Year 2026 Guidance**


PIOMBINO DESE, Italy--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Stevanato Group S.p.A.](http://www.stevanatogroup.com/) (NYSE: STVN), a leading global provider of drug containment, drug delivery, and diagnostic solutions to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences industries, today announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026.


**Third Quarter of 2026 Highlights (comparisons to prior-year period)**


- Revenue increased 8% to €326.1 million, and on an organic basis* revenue increased 8%.
- Revenue from high-value solutions represented 46% of total revenue.
- Gross profit was €95.0 million and gross profit margin was 29.1%.
- Adjusted EBITDA margin increased 150 basis points to 27.2%.
- Diluted earnings per share grew 15% to €0.15 and adjusted diluted earnings per share grew 14% to €0.16.
- The Company is maintaining its fiscal 2026 guidance and continues to expect revenue in the range of €1.260 billion to €1.280 billion, adjusted EBITDA of €335.0 million to €345.2 million, and adjusted diluted EPS of €0.60 to €0.62.


**Organic revenue is defined as reported revenue excluding the effects from divestments and/or acquisitions, and the impacts of foreign currency translation. Please refer to the financial table titled "Reconciliation of Revenue to Organic Revenue" included in the Non-GAAP Financial Information provided in this press release.*


**Third Quarter 2026 Results**


For the third quarter of 2026, revenue increased 8% to €326.1 million, and 8% organically, compared to the same period last year. This was driven by an 11% revenue increase, on an organic basis, from the Company's Biopharmaceutical and Diagnostic Solutions (BDS) Segment, which offset a 12% revenue decline from the Engineering Segment. Revenue from high-value solutions increased 1%, year-over-year, to €149.4 million, and 1% on an organic basis, and represented 46% of total revenue for the third quarter of 2026. In the third quarter of 2026, revenue from GLP-1 therapies represented approximately 17% to 18% of total revenue.


In the third quarter of 2026, gross profit margin decreased 10 basis points to 29.1% primarily due to increased utility costs, the expected higher depreciation, and lower gross profit from the Engineering Segment, which were partially offset by the expected combined margin improvements in Latina and Fishers and a better mix compared to the same period last year.


Operating profit margin increased by 110 basis points to 18.5% and adjusted operating profit margin increased by 90 basis points to 19.4%. Net profit increased 16% to €41.8 million, with diluted earnings per share of €0.15. For the third quarter of 2026, adjusted net profit increased 14% to €44.0 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share increased to €0.16, compared with €0.14 for the same period last year.


For the third quarter of 2026, adjusted EBITDA increased 14% to €88.8 million, and adjusted EBITDA margin improved 150 basis points to 27.2%, compared with the same period last year.


Franco Stevanato, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, commented, “Third-quarter results were in line with our expectations, with 8% organic revenue growth and a 150-basis-point expansion in adjusted EBITDA margin. Solid growth in our Biopharmaceutical and Diagnostics Solutions Segment and continued demand in non-GLP-1 biologics, which grew over 30% in the third quarter, helped offset lower GLP-1 revenue and softer performance in the Engineering Segment. Looking to next year, we now anticipate lower volumes and revenue from GLP-1s than previously expected which we believe will temporarily moderate growth in 2027. We have already made meaningful progress in backfilling the expected lower revenue and we remain confident in our ability to grow low single digits next year, based on what we know today.”


**Biopharmaceutical and Diagnostic Solutions (BDS) Segment**


Revenue of €294.0 million, grew 10% and increased 11% organically, compared with the same period last year, driven by growth in high-value solutions and other containment and delivery solutions.


In the third quarter of 2026, revenue from high-value solutions increased 1% to €149.4 million, and also grew 1% organically, and represented 51% of BDS Segment revenue, driven predominantly by EZ-fill® syringes and EZ-fill® cartridges. Revenue from other containment and delivery solutions of €144.6 million, grew 22% and increased 23% organically, compared with the same period last year, driven by growth in bulk syringes and cartridges, and variable compensation tied to lower GLP-1 volumes.


For the third quarter of 2026, gross profit grew €8.9 million to €94.6 million, and gross profit margin increased by 10 basis points to 32.1%, compared to the prior-year period. This was primarily driven by higher revenue, the combined improvements in Fishers and Latina as we continue to scale operations and gain efficiencies, and a better portfolio mix, which was partially offset by increased utility costs and the expected higher depreciation.


**Engineering Segment**


Revenue from the Engineering Segment decreased 12% to €32.0 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared with the same period last year, driven primarily by lower revenue from pharma visual inspection, and assembly and packaging, which offset growth in after sales services.


For the third quarter of 2026, gross profit margin for the Engineering Segment decreased 20 basis points to 10.2%, compared with the same period last year, due to lower revenue, the timing of order intake, and project execution.


**Balance Sheet and Cash Flow**


As of September 30, 2026, the Company had cash and cash equivalents of €114.9 million, and net debt of €353.7 million.


For the third quarter of 2026, capital expenditures totaled €44.8 million, primarily related to the new plants in Italy and Indiana, and the device programs in Germany. For the three-months ended September 30, 2026, net cash flow from operating activities was €57.6 million and cash used for the purchase of property, plant, and equipment, and intangible assets totaled €36.3 million. In the third quarter of 2026, the Company generated free cash flow of €21.7 million.


The Company believes that it has adequate liquidity to fund its strategic priorities over at least the next twelve months through a combination of cash on hand, cash generated from operations, available credit lines, and the ability to access additional financing.


**Full Year 2026 Guidance**


The Company is maintaining its full-year 2026 guidance and still expects revenue to range between €1.260 billion and €1.280 billion, adjusted EBITDA of €335.0 million to €345.2 million, and adjusted diluted EPS of €0.60 to €0.62.


Franco Stevanato, concluded, "The demand environment for injectable biologics remains structurally strong, supported by scientific innovation, the expansion of biosimilars and the shift toward self-administered therapies. We continue to invest with discipline in high-value containment and delivery solutions, expand capacity across our global network, and advance differentiated platforms such as our groundbreaking Alba® syringes to our integrated device platforms such as our Alina® pen injector. These capabilities position Stevanato Group to support customers across the drug lifecycle and deliver sustainable, profitable long-term growth."

**About Stevanato Group**


Founded in 1949, Stevanato Group is a leading global provider of drug containment, drug delivery and diagnostic solutions to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences industries. The Group delivers an integrated, end-to-end portfolio of products, processes, and services that address customer needs across the entire drug life cycle at each of the development, clinical and commercial stages. Stevanato Group’s core capabilities in scientific research and development, its commitment to technical innovation, and its engineering excellence are central to its ability to offer value added solutions to clients. To learn more, visit:[www.stevanatogroup.com](http://www.stevanatogroup.com/) .
